description: This file defines the LicenseService class, which provides methods for managing licensing information in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It interacts with a LicenseDao data access object to perform CRUD operations and license searches.

classes.name: LicenseService
classes.description: Service class providing license management functionalities, including creation, retrieval, deletion, and validation within the licensing module.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Saves a License object, either creating a new record or updating an existing one.

methods.name: getLicenseDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LicenseDao object for database operations.

methods.name: setLicenseDao
methods.description: Sets the LicenseDao object, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: getLicenseById
methods.description: Retrieves a License by its ID.

methods.name: getLicenseByName
methods.description: Retrieves a License by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getLicenseList
methods.description: Returns a list of licenses based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLicenseCount
methods.description: Returns the count of licenses matching search criteria.

methods.name: deleteLicenses
methods.description: Deletes multiple licenses identified by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Checks if a license name already exists, case-insensitive.
